units.source_text: 匂亲王回思今晚好不容易抽暇来此，想起今后还是不能自由往来，心中不胜悲伤。

en.t: Prince Niou thought back on how he had barely managed to find time to come here tonight, and when he considered that even from now on he still would not be able to come and go freely, his heart was filled with sorrow.

units.source_text: 便把母后对他说的话告诉二女公子，又说：“我心中虽然想念你，但未必常能与你相聚，请你切勿怀疑我是无情。

en.t: He then told the Second Princess what his mother had said to him, and added, Even though I long for you in my heart, I may not always be able to be with you, so please do not suspect me of being cold or unfeeling.

units.source_text: 我对你如果略有一点疏蔑之意，今夜就不会排除万难而来与你相会了。

en.t: If I had even the slightest intention of neglecting or slighting you, I would not have overcome every difficulty tonight to come and meet you.

units.source_text: 我惟恐你怀疑我心，胡思乱想，因此不顾一切，毅然出门。

en.t: I was afraid only that you might doubt my heart and torment yourself with needless thoughts, and so I cast everything aside and resolutely set out.

units.source_text: 但今后深恐不能常常如此，所以我要想个妥当办法，迎接你迁往京中。”

en.t: But I greatly fear that from now on I will not often be able to do this, so I must think of a proper way to bring you to live in the capital.

units.source_text: 他这番话说得十分诚恳。

en.t: He spoke these words with great sincerity.

units.source_text: 但二女公子想道：“他现在就想到今后不能常常相聚，则世间传说此人浮薄，恐怕是真的了。”

en.t: But the Second Princess thought, If he is already thinking now that we will not often be able to meet in the future, then what people say about him being fickle is probably true.

units.source_text: 她心情不快，回思自己生涯，顿感万种悲伤。

en.t: Her spirits sank, and as she thought back over her own life, she was suddenly overcome by countless sorrows.
